sources.title: LTX-2.3: Previous Generation AI Video Model | LTX
sources.snippet: LTX-2.3 is the previous LTX release. Open weights, synchronized audio, and native portrait video. Still fully supported. LTX-2.5 is the current model.

sources.title: LTX Video 2.3 - AI Model | Layer
sources.snippet: LTX Video 2.3 is the latest generation video model from Lightricks, featuring a new VAE architecture for enhanced detail reproduction and improved prompt comprehension.

sources.title: LTX 2.3 AI Video Generator — 4K Ultra HD, 20 Seconds | Verbatik AI
sources.snippet: Generate 4K AI videos up to 20 seconds with LTX 2.3. The only AI video model offering 2160p resolution, audio-to-video generation, and extended duration for professional content.

sources.title: LTX-2.3 - AI Model Library | Build on Vast.ai
sources.snippet: LTX-2.3 is a DiT-based (Diffusion Transformer) audio-video foundation model developed by Lightricks, representing a significant update to LTX-2 with improved audio and visual quality alongside enhanced prompt adherence.
